# function: redshift_securitygroupingress_ec2securitygroup

Builds the ARN for `redshift` `securitygroupingress-ec2securitygroup`:

```
arn:${Partition}:redshift:${Region}:${Account}:securitygroupingress:${SecurityGroupName}/ec2securitygroup/${Owner}/${Ece2SecuritygroupId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:redshift:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:securitygroupingress:security-group-name/ec2securitygroup/owner/ece2-securitygroup-id
output "redshift_securitygroupingress_ec2securitygroup" {
  value = provider::arn::redshift_securitygroupingress_ec2securitygroup("security-group-name", "owner", "ece2-securitygroup-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
redshift_securitygroupingress_ec2securitygroup(security_group_name string, owner string, ece2_securitygroup_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `security_group_name` (String) Value for `${SecurityGroupName}` in the ARN template.
1. `owner` (String) Value for `${Owner}` in the ARN template.
1. `ece2_securitygroup_id` (String) Value for `${Ece2SecuritygroupId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
